title: State Commission or National Commission Must Impose Costs for Adjournment

content.scenario: During the hearing of an appeal, the respondent requests an adjournment, which is granted by the State Commission. The appellant, Rohan, requests the Commission to impose costs for the adjournment.
content.outcome: The State Commission or National Commission must impose costs for the adjournment, as specified by regulations, under the second proviso to section 52 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: Can the State Commission impose costs for adjournment?
What are the regulations for imposing costs for adjournment?
How are costs for adjournment calculated?
